items.name: Document Extractor

items.name: Document Converter

items.name: PDF Merge & Split

howItWorks.description: No plugins, no copying and pasting. Everything happens in your browser.

steps.title: Configure

steps.title: Translate

steps.title: Review & edit
steps.body: Open the result in the browser editor and fix wording, headings, lists, or tables.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Export as PDF or DOCX, with the translated text placed where the original was.

review.title: AI does the heavy lifting. You get the final say.
review.description: Every translation opens in an editor, so you can polish terminology and tone before the document goes anywhere.

points.title: Download PDF or DOCX

features.title: Translation that respects your document
features.description: Generic translators treat a file as one long string of text. Document Doctor understands its structure, so the result reads naturally and still looks like your document.

items.title: Layout stays intact
items.body: Translated passages are written back where the original text was, so pages, headings, tables, and spacing stay in place.

items.title: Structure-aware translation
items.body: Documents are split into headings, paragraphs, list items, and table cells instead of arbitrary chunks, for more accurate context.

items.title: Pick a translation style
items.body: General, professional, formal, casual, academic, technical, or legal — so a contract stays formal and a guide stays friendly.

items.title: Clear progress
items.body: Each processing stage is shown as it completes, and if something fails you get a message that says what went wrong.

items.title: Edit the result
items.body: Open the translation in a browser editor to adjust wording, formatting, lists, and tables before you export.

items.title: PDF or DOCX out
items.body: Download a PDF, or a Word file you can keep editing. No separate conversion step.

languages.title: 8 languages, translated in any direction
languages.description: Pick any language as the source and any other as the target — for example Indonesian to English, English to Chinese, or Japanese to Indonesian.

items.question: What is Document Doctor?
items.answer: Document Doctor is a collection of simple AI-powered tools for working with documents and digital files. Each tool handles one job, and they all live in one web app.

items.question: Which tools can I use today?
items.answer: All of them: the Document Translator, Summarizer and Extractor, the Document Converter (PDF ⇄ Word), PDF Merge & Split, and the Image Resizer and Compressor.

items.question: Which file types can the translator handle?
items.answer: PDF (.pdf) and Microsoft Word (.docx) documents up to 5 MB. You can download the result as PDF or DOCX.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: Indonesian, English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, and Spanish. You can translate from any of these languages into any other.

items.question: Can I edit the translation before downloading?
items.answer: Yes. After translation you can open the result in a browser editor to change text, headings, lists, links, and basic tables, then export your edited version.

items.question: Will my document's formatting be preserved?
items.answer: Document Doctor places each translated passage where its original text was, so headings, paragraphs, tables, and page structure stay in place. Translations can be longer or shorter than the original, so small spacing adjustments may occur.

items.question: Can I translate scanned PDFs?
items.answer: Not yet. The translator needs PDFs with selectable text. Scanned documents that contain only images of text are not currently supported.
